pages.text: One quiet night, <name> peeked out his window and saw a tiny fairy sitting on a silver cloud, looking sad. “Hello,” he whispered. “I’m <name>. Why are you sad?”
“I lost my star crown,” said the fairy. “Without it, I can’t light the night.”

<name> wanted to help. Suddenly, a wise owl swooped down. “Follow the twinkling path,” it hooted. A sleepy bear yawned and pointed to a tall, gentle tree. “Climb carefully,” it mumbled. And a dancing firefly zipped around, showing the way.
<name> tiptoed up the tree and found the crown resting on a soft branch. A tiny riddle floated in the air: “What sparkles most when shared with care?”
“Kindness!” <name> shouted. Instantly, the crown floated into his hands. He gently gave it to the moon fairy.
The fairy twirled with joy, her wings glittering like starlight. “Thank you, <name>,” she said, placing a glowing star above his bed. “Whenever you look at it, remember the magic of helping others.”
<name> snuggled under his blanket, smiling, as the star sparkled and the night felt warm and happy.
